title: Prominent Democratic Attorney Marc Elias Targeted in Justice Department Alaska Ballot Probe
meta_title: Marc Elias Targeted in DOJ Alaska Ballot Probe, Sources Say
meta_description: Prominent Democratic attorney Marc Elias has been targeted in a Justice Department criminal investigation concerning an Alaska ballot scheme.

Justice Department Investigates Democrats Over Alaska Ballot Scheme
Marc Elias Receives Target Letter From DOJ Amid Ongoing Investigation
spot: Prominent Democratic attorney Marc Elias and his law firm have become targets in a Justice Department criminal investigation examining whether Democrats recruited a same-name candidate to confuse voters during an Alaska Senate race.
content_html:
Key Developments

Prominent Democratic attorney and vocal Trump administration critic Marc Elias is a target in a Justice Department criminal investigation. The probe centers on allegations that Democrats sought to confuse voters in Alaska by recruiting a third-party candidate sharing the same name as Republican incumbent Senator Dan Sullivan, according to a law enforcement official and a second source familiar with the matter.

Elias is among approximately 20 individuals who have received target letters, preservation letters, or grand jury subpoenas from the Justice Department. The investigation is being led by the U.S. Attorney's Office in Alaska and includes prosecutors from the Civil Rights Division's criminal section. Additionally, the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee (DSCC) has received a separate grand jury subpoena.

President Trump recently posted public statements on social media criticizing Elias and calling for his prosecution. Elias strongly denied any wrongdoing, releasing a statement that characterized the investigation as a politically motivated sham by an administration weaponizing the DOJ against its political enemies.

Key Takeaways

  • Targets Identified: Attorney Marc Elias and roughly 20 other individuals have received target or preservation letters from the Justice Department.
  • Core Investigation: The criminal probe focuses on whether Democrats attempted to confuse voters by recruiting a candidate with the same name as Republican Senator Dan Sullivan in Alaska.
  • Wider Subpoenas: The Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee has also been issued a grand jury subpoena in connection with the ongoing inquiry.

Why It Matters

The investigation highlights escalating tensions between the Trump administration and prominent Democratic legal figures. Federal prosecutors have not formally specified the precise criminal statutes being investigated, though White House officials have previously referenced civil rights statutes regarding conspiracies to interfere with constitutional voting rights. The timing of the letters, distributed on Election Day, underscores the high-stakes intersection of federal law enforcement and partisan political conflicts.
